### Changed
- **The Substrate line moves to `v0.0.30-gs.2`: the worker pool can be spread over nodes and zones** (giantswarm/agent-platform#472, second half; the carried patch giantswarm/giantswarm#37797, #37742 row 46). `v0.0.30-gs.2` is the first release whose `WorkerPool` CRD carries `spec.template.topologySpreadConstraints` (an atomic list of at most 8) and `spec.template.podAntiAffinity`, mapped onto the worker pods next to `nodeAffinity`; every release before it pruned both at admission. `components.substrate` / `components.substrate-crds` move to `>=0.0.30-gs.2 <0.0.31-0` and `agent-platform.substrate.workerPoolSpreadFloor` names the release, so the render guard of 4.20.0 now **forwards** `kagent.substrateWorkerPool.template.topologySpreadConstraints` / `podAntiAffinity` verbatim to the kagent release and the `WorkerPool`, and refuses them — naming the key, the floor and the range — only on an installation whose Substrate range floor is pinned below it. The worker image the kagent chart stamps stays `ateom-gvisor:0.0.30-gs.1` (kagent `0.11.0-gs.14` on) and runs under the gs.2 control plane: the release changes ate-controller, the CRD and ate-api only, so the Substrate pin and the kagent pin part ways for the first time (values.yaml says when they move together: a re-pin that changes the runtime). The release also carries giantswarm/substrate#35 (a paused actor's resume fails fast when its node is gone, `LOCAL_SNAPSHOT_GONE`, #37742 row 44a). The example BOM, `tests/verify-components.py` and `make verify-workerpool` follow the pin: the spread now reaches the kagent release at the floor and is refused below it, the two branches the test exercised with a temporary floor before. **Every installation with kagent on rolls the Substrate control plane once** (the CRDs gain the two fields, ate-api-server / ate-controller / atenet / atelet restart); the worker pods, the `WorkerPool` template and the goldens are untouched — UPGRADE.md.
